## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `0c5eed2cb925bb868f69ac77a1fdca44a4a3d331`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #33650 body and all six comments (triage 6889355499, claim 6889553393, amendments 6889564701 and 6890161273, os-dev-report 6890090496), PR #33679 body and its 18-file list, the net diff `3c0033f9..0c5eed2c` (merge base with `main`; `main` has no commit touching these paths since), and the check-runs on the head. better-auth 1.7.12 is not installed in this checkout (`node_modules` absent), so the vendor claims (`crud-invites.mjs` `getInvitation` throws a code-less 400 for every non-pending row; every other 400 on that route is coded) are judged from the lines the card and the PR quote, not re-read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/auth`: errors thrown through `toAuthError` gain a numeric `status`.** Right. Widening only: `message`, `code`, `dependents`, `userMessage` and `details` are unchanged. The only type that changes is `AuthClientError`, which is internal to the module (not re-exported from `index.ts`). The two-factor and phone-OTP error builders in the same file already carried `status`, so this matches what the file already does. Consumer check: none of the `.status` reads on caught errors in `ui/packages/app-shell/src` or `ui/apps/console/src` (outside tests) handle an auth-client rejection. They are data-API errors, such as FormPage, useRecordApprovals and Marketplace. No existing branch starts firing because the property is now present.
- **New entry point `resolveInvitationLookupMessage` (app-shell `orgErrorMessage.ts`).** Right. Its accept-set is exactly `code === undefined && status === 400`, which maps to `organization.errors.invitationNotFound`. Everything else goes through `resolveOrgErrorMessage` with the same key as the fallback, where the page passed that key inline before. It is keyed on the route, because its only caller is `AcceptInvitationPage`'s `getInvitation` catch. It never reads the English text, so the objectui#4474 rule holds. The CONTROLs pin both edges: a coded 400 on the same route and a code-less 401. Ablation A2 in the report shows that removing the status condition turns the 401 CONTROL red.
- **`ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` gains `USER_IS_ALREADY_A_MEMBER_OF_THIS_ORGANIZATION`, mapped to `organization.errors.alreadyMember`.** Right. The mapped-code set grows by one row, and the census in `orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts` names it. The invite dialog picks it up through the table and needs no edit of its own.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: new key `organization.errors.alreadyMember` in all 11 packs.** Right. Ten packs are hand-written. In `zh-Hant`, the strings match the `zh-Hans` strings after script conversion, which fits the claim that the pack was generated. The census pin requires a string in every pack and checks that no non-English pack copies the English.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: `organization.errors.invitationNotFound` reworded in all 11 packs.** Right. This changes only the copy; the key set and the type stay the same. The same key also backs the coded `INVITATION_NOT_FOUND` toast on `accept-invitation`, and the new sentence is accurate there too. That path is pinned by a CONTROL.
- **File surface against the claim.** Right. Every changed path is in the claimed surface: claim 6889553393, plus amendment 6889564701 for `createAuthClient.ts` and its test. No `packages/**`, spec, server or better-auth patch is touched.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/33650-invitation-refusal-copy.md` bumps `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/auth` and `@object-ui/i18n` at `patch`. That is right: AGENTS.md section 3 says a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` and is consumed by `@object-ui/console` as `workspace:*`, so it ships through the console row. The precedent PR #33485 did the same.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Right. The PR body, the changeset body and the claim amendment 6890161273 all say the same thing. The widening is the new i18n key and the extra `status` property on thrown errors. Nothing is removed or narrowed, and no exported type changes.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. Right. Nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- A `Check Changeset` run on this head concluded `success`. A second run is in progress, and the third was cancelled because it was superseded.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` is empty in os-dev-report 6890090496. Nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope finding (a), the server card for the already-accepted invitation.** Escalated, should-fix, owed by the seat. Card #33650's Expected asks for an "already joined, enter the organization" state. The PR delivers only the card's own fallback (Suggested fix 3: "at least word the error so it covers the accepted case"), and the record accepts that as enough to close the card. But `Fixes #33650` closes the card, and no carrier for the server-side remainder exists yet: a search of the repo for issues finds only #33650 itself. File the server card before landing, or name its number when the card is closed, so the expectation is not lost with the closure.
- **Out-of-scope finding (b), the same 400 for expired, rejected and canceled invitations.** Answered by the diff: the console sentence covers those states, and the report gives no carrier. Accepted.
- **Nit:** the not-found sentence says "has already been used, has expired, or was revoked". For an unknown id (a typo, or a link from another environment) none of the three is true. A row the invitee declined (`rejected`) is covered only loosely by "revoked". This changes no behaviour, and the card's own wording suggestion asked for exactly this sentence.
- **Nit:** the comment on `resolveInvitationLookupMessage` says that every other 400 on `get-invitation` is coded. No pin covers that against the vendor; only the PR quotes it. If better-call ever answered a code-less 400 for a malformed query, the page would show the not-found sentence. That fails safe, and the page always sends an `id`.
- Check-runs on the head as of 2026-11-15T06:12Z: 16 success, 19 skipped, 1 cancelled (the superseded `Check Changeset`), 28 still in progress (Test UI 1-16, Type Check UI and its four lanes, Lint UI and its scoped lanes, Build & E2E UI, the rerun of `Check Changeset`), and none failed. These conclusions are the gate verdicts. This PASS is on the contract, and landing still waits for every one of them to finish green.

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `0c5eed2c` · 2026-11-15T06:28Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #33650`. 18 files, all on the amended surface (claim 6889553393, amendments 6889564701 and 6890161273):
   - `resolveInvitationLookupMessage`: `get-invitation`'s code-less 400 now reads as the console's not-found sentence. It keys on the route, the status and the missing code, never on English text.
   - A new `USER_IS_ALREADY_A_MEMBER_OF_THIS_ORGANIZATION` row in `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS`.
   - `@object-ui/auth` `toAuthError` now carries `status`.
   - `organization.errors.alreadyMember` is added and `invitationNotFound` is reworded, in all 11 packs.
   - Pins and one changeset.
2. **Premise.** On base `3c0033f9` all three faces reproduced: 7 red, and 4 CONTROLs green. Face 3 (an accepted invitation) is worded rather than detected, because the vendor gives it the same code-less 400 as an unknown id. Per the order's fallback, the sentence covers used, expired and revoked, and points to the organization list.
3. **Contract record.** PASS 6890217201 (`TIER_DEFAULT`, declaration face) on this head.
   - `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right, as are `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch` on console, auth and i18n.
   - Its one should-fix was a process item: file the server card before landing. That is done as #33681 (`domain:server`, p3).
   - Two nits stay as accepted deviations. The sentence says "used, expired or revoked" even for a never-valid id. The claim "every other get-invitation 400 is coded" is unpinned; if it is wrong, the page fails safe.
4. **Gates on head `0c5eed2c`.**
   - 70 check runs: 48 `success`, 21 `skipped`, 1 `cancelled`, 0 failed. The cancelled run is a superseded Check Changeset; the rerun on this head is `success`.
   - Locally: 39/39 derived gates. 4 ablations each turned red and were restored.
5. **Seat edit.** The PR body was re-declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` by the seat (issue_patch, signed), following the dev's r2 text. That is a body edit only; the head stays the same.
6. **K.** 23 first-parent commits since base `3c0033f9` ≥ 15, so I synced the base. That merged `main` at `36936440` and made the new head `97882224`. The sync is merge-only: patch-id `79cbbe69dfb1` is the same on both heads. The landing waits for the rerun to go green.
7. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
